headline: Hubbell’s (NYSE:HUBB) Q2 CY2026: Beats On Revenue
summary: Electrical and electronic products company Hubbell (NYSE:HUBB) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 15.3% year on year to $1.71 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $5.52 per share was 2.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
